subject.title: [Bug]: Preflight compaction failure permanently locks Composer into "terminated" state

question: Which linked PR should be treated as the canonical fix path for this issue's preflight compaction retryability contract?
rationale: Current main is still broken and three open closing PRs target the same root cause with different risk profiles, so automation should not close or start another fix before a maintainer chooses the canonical landing path.

options.title: Use the narrowed runtime PR after proof
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101241 as the likely canonical path if it keeps 400/401/403 terminal and adds real behavior proof.

options.title: Repair the classifier-split PR first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101285 only after it resolves the 429 billing/entitlement classification concern and supplies proof.

options.title: Switch to UI lifecycle recovery
options.body: Reject fail-open runtime behavior and instead require a gateway/UI recovery fix with live WebChat proof.

recommendation.title: Use the narrowed runtime PR after proof
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101241 as the likely canonical path if it keeps 400/401/403 terminal and adds real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the concrete prior retryability guidance that the current candidates are trying to satisfy.
